text.tspan: The Target Reset detector is enabled whenever the Target-side
logic is in use and `enable_i` has become asserted, indicating that
it's safe to propagate SDA and SCL into the detector.
The detector counts SDA pulses whilst SCL is low and then asserts
the appropriate control output upon detection of Sr (Repeated Start)
During normal operation of the Target, the detector may be used by
the IP block to listen for any Target/Device resets sent by the Controller,
in conjunction with the processing of RSTACT CCCs within the IP block.
When the chip is placed in 'Deepest Sleep' state the detector may be
used to listen for Wake up signaling (standalone Target Reset pattern
